title: `read_the_swing`: Read the Swing (Breaker rank II)
notes:
- **Mode:** Wick icon, 1024 x 1024 PNG, transparent.
- **Save as:** `art/icons/moves/read-the-swing.png`.
- **Shows:** Class move card. When a blow misses the Breaker, the miss feeds his Momentum.
paint: Wick leaning hard out of the way of a blow: head and shoulders tipped aside, one foot stepping off the line, and a single wide curved band (the cut-off arc of a swing from the edge of the frame) passing through the exact place where his head was a heartbeat ago, left empty. Two small short marks at the side of his head show him watching it come. His free hand is open and low, ready to take the momentum. At icon size it must read as a figure dodging a curved band that goes through empty space. It must look different from Called Out (no shield, no pointing, no calling). Avoid: the blow hitting, a spiral, a swirl of dust, an eye icon, an arrow, text.
staging: One broad white swing-band passes above and to the right of Wick's tilted head across transparent emptiness. Clear bent knee near stance, one foot stepping aside and one open hand low. No shield.
label: Read the Swing (Breaker rank II)
prompt:
Draw one icon in pure white flat ink (#FFFFFF) on a fully transparent background, in exactly the style of the attached reference icons: Wick, the small figure of the trait and perk icons with the ceramic pixel-screen head, capelet and lantern heart, in bold flat white shapes, a confident inked silhouette with a few interior cuts, the same line weight. No outline in another colour, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no glow, no colour and no grey. Wick is the only full figure; anyone else is a partial (a hand, a shoulder, a silhouette cut by the frame). One action, centred, with clear space around it, square, 1024 x 1024 PNG with transparency. It must read at 32 px in a row and at 44 px on a chip: silhouette first, two or three interior cuts at most. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame. Invented shapes only: nothing recognisable from real-world works, brands, insignia or religions. The icon shows:
Wick leaning hard out of the way of a blow: head and shoulders tipped aside, one foot stepping off the line, and a single wide curved band (the cut-off arc of a swing from the edge of the frame) passing through the exact place where his head was a heartbeat ago, left empty. Two small short marks at the side of his head show him watching it come. His free hand is open and low, ready to take the momentum. At icon size it must read as a figure dodging a curved band that goes through empty space. It must look different from Called Out (no shield, no pointing, no calling). Avoid: the blow hitting, a spiral, a swirl of dust, an eye icon, an arrow, text.
Wick always has the exact approved oversized rounded ceramic screen head, transparent face recess with white pixel expression, ear discs, offset shell fittings, short asymmetric capelet, lantern-heart inset, chunky mitten hands and cuffed boots. The silhouette of the head ends at the smooth ceramic shell. There is NO flame, tuft, plume, candle or object attached to or above his head. Resolve any stale flame wording through the angle or pixel expression. Omit default floating cup and reference arrows.
One broad white swing-band passes above and to the right of Wick's tilted head across transparent emptiness. Clear bent knee near stance, one foot stepping aside and one open hand low. No shield. 
All dark voids are physically transparent alpha cutouts, never solid black or gray. Clear border, stable negative space at game size, pure white flat ink.
